title: Multi-Headed Attention Visualization
full_prompt: Write a Manim script using ManimGL/InteractiveScene that visualizes the transition from a single attention head to multi-headed attention in a Transformer model. First, display the title 'Single head of attention' with a screen rectangle below it. Highlight the word 'head' using a FlashAround animation. Next, morph the title into 'Multi-headed attention' using precise FadeTransform animations on the text slices. Then, transition the camera into a 3D perspective (using set_floor_plane('xz') and frame reorientation) while keeping the title fixed in the frame. Stack multiple attention pattern layers (represented by ImageMobjects or styled SurroundingRectangles) along the Z-axis (using the OUT direction) and animate them fading in sequentially with a LaggedStart animation to show parallel multi-head processing.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Missing local image assets causing runtime crashes
common_failure_modes.note: The code references local attention pattern images. Fallback mock rectangles or dynamically generated noise patterns must be used if assets are missing.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Manim Community vs ManimGL API mismatch
common_failure_modes.note: Using self.frame or fix_in_frame() in Manim Community will fail. Must use ThreeDScene equivalents if porting.
Slicing Text objects like single_title['Single'] requires precise substring matching or specific indexing which can easily break.
